sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can narrate a day that went wrong using elkésik, elveszít, sajnos, and szerencsére.
I can tell a short funny story using nevet with the superessive case, building toward the punchline with aztán and utána.
I can talk about a past trip using utazik, and set the scene of a story with amikor.
I can describe a surprising event using egyszer csak or váratlanul with elkezd, and report what someone said using azt mondta, hogy...
I can frame and tell a complete short story using az elején, a végén, and the storytelling connectors from this unit.
